title: Odd symmetrized check value
statement: Given a sign query check and a bounded real-valued function on the sign cube, take the uniform average over all choices of predicate input positions to negate of the check's randomized value after negating the selected queries. This average is the odd symmetrized value of the check on the function.
hypotheses_covered: A sign query check on the Boolean cube of dimension n
A bounded cube function with values in $[-1,1]
